attributes.visState:
{"title": "RMM - Guide", "type": "markdown", "aggs": [], "params": {"fontSize": 11, "openLinksInNewTab": true, "markdown": "### RMM Abuse Detection

Remote access tools (AnyDesk, ScreenConnect, TeamViewer and 20 more) seen on Windows endpoints. MITRE ATT&CK **T1219**.

| Level | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **12** | Renamed tool, tool opened a shell, or 2+ vendors on one PC. **Investigate now.** |
| **10** | Tool run from Downloads, Desktop or Temp |
| **8** | Tool started |
| **6** | Tool contacted its service (DNS) |

Approve your company's own tool in `rmm_allowlist.xml`."}}
